verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents reading account data from a linked bank (Data API) and verifying that an account belongs to a user via open-banking consent rather than micro-deposits. It also stores bank account details for future payment initiation and supports mandates, including Direct Debits, that execute without further authorisation. However, the evidence never states that verified account/sort-code numbers or a token are returned to fund debits, and coverage is UK/EU rather than ACH. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that account and sort-code numbers (or tokenized equivalents) are returned from linked accounts, an explicit statement that no micro-deposits are needed, ACH/US routing-number support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
